name: auth_refresh
description: Access token nears expiry. SDK proactively refreshes over HTTP before the buffer expires, then reconnects and continues.

steps.note: Initial session established with access_token_v1; payload copied from runtime_bootstrap returned by /auth/token; session_id omitted on outbound system::init; SDK generates meta.client_msg_id
session_id: sess_abc123, seq: 1 — canonical bootstrap ack from SessionManager
session_id: sess_abc123 — sent while token is still valid
--- OUT OF BAND: token expiry approaches (expires_at - now < 60s buffer) ---
--- OUT OF BAND: SDK sends HTTP POST https://cortexsuite.app/auth/refresh with Authorization: Bearer <refresh_token> ---
--- OUT OF BAND: SDK closes current WebSocket and reopens with cortex-sdk.jwt.access_token_v2 subprotocol ---
session_id: sess_abc123 — resync after reconnect with new token; last_seq=2 (bootstrap ack and first answer were already received); same session_id preserved
session_id: sess_abc123 — sent with refreshed token
session_id: sess_abc123, seq: 3 — session uninterrupted across token refresh
